How we go about it

We are a small independent studio in the UK. We make Chrome extensions that take things away rather than add them. We publish the source too, so you never have to take our word for what they do.

One job, done properly

Every extension has a single purpose. If a feature does not serve that purpose it does not ship, however much we would enjoy building it.

The fewest permissions we can ask for

Two of them ask for a single permission and access to the one site they are for. The third starts with no access to any site at all, and asks for one domain at a time, at the moment you press the button.

Read the code yourself

Everything we ship is MIT licensed, with the source public on GitHub. Nothing is sent anywhere. There is no server and no analytics. You do not have to trust us on that, because you can check it yourself.

Free, and staying free.

All three extensions are free, MIT licensed and always will be. There is no paid tier waiting behind them. If one has saved you some irritation and you feel like putting something in the hat, it keeps the work going. If not, that is genuinely fine.
